tavern: Every carpet now ends at a solid trim, as 02's does (01, 03 and 04 had been blended into the boards); 05's rugs are as before. The brick behind each bar has a stone border across the barkeep's opening, where the edge shows.
throne_room: Each throne room now has its own plan, not only new pieces: 01 is your round 3 room unchanged; 02 sets the throne out on a dais in the room with benches round it; 03 has twin thrones; 04 is a petition hall with rows of benches and no runner; 05 puts the throne in an apse of columns with galleries down both sides.
great_hall: The brick border round each hall now has its edge all the way round, the north-east wall included, and every carpet its whole trim in a colour that stands out from the carpet (01's north-east side was missing). The cause was a half-tile error in where wall seams lie, fixed for every room.
hall: 01 and 03 now follow the plan of 02 and 04: one straight colonnade each side of the aisle and no extra rows of statues and urns, filled with a fountain at the far end, a carpeted nave, and benches, urns and plants along the walls; 02, 04 and 05 are unchanged.
